exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Fine for driving a vehicle without valid insurance (first offence)?
card text: Section 196: driving an uninsured vehicle — first offence up to 3 months jail and/or Rs 2,000; repeat Rs 4,000.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Validity of temporary registration of a new vehicle?
card text: Temporary registration (Section 43) is valid for one month (30 days).

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: The EGR valve helps reduce?
card text: EGR (exhaust gas recirculation) sends some exhaust back into the intake to lower combustion temperature and cut NOx.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Distance between the centre lines of front and rear axles is?
card text: Wheel base = distance between front and rear axle centres.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Number plates of electric transport vehicles?
card text: Electric transport vehicles: yellow letters on green background. Private EVs: white letters on green.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: MACT deals with?
card text: MACT = Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal. It decides compensation claims for road accidents (Chapter XII of MV Act).

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Over-speeding violates which section of the MV Act, 1988?
card text: Section 112: limits of speed. Driving above the speed limit violates it (penalty under Section 183).

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: A centrifugal pump delivers only when the pressure rise in the impeller equals the?
card text: A centrifugal pump starts delivering only when the pressure rise in the impeller equals or exceeds the manometric head.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: A tank holds water 1.3 m deep. Water force on a side wall per metre length?
card text: Force on a vertical wall per metre = ρgh²/2 = 1000 × 9.81 × 1.3² / 2 ≈ 8.29 kN.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Shock-resisting steels should have?
card text: Shock-resisting steels must be tough — able to absorb impact energy without breaking.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Eutectoid steel consists of?
card text: Eutectoid steel (about 0.8% carbon) is 100% pearlite at room temperature.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Carbon content of cast iron varies from?
card text: Cast iron has about 1.7% to 4.5% carbon. Steel has less than about 1.7%.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Static friction is always ___ dynamic friction.
card text: Static (limiting) friction is greater than dynamic (kinetic) friction.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Purpose of a draft tube in a reaction turbine?
answer: Convert kinetic energy to pressure energy by gradual expansion
card text: A draft tube is a widening pipe at the turbine outlet; it recovers kinetic energy as pressure energy.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: A four-cylinder engine has 2.4 litre capacity. Swept volume of one cylinder?
card text: Swept volume per cylinder = engine capacity / number of cylinders = 2400 / 4 = 600 cc.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Coefficient of contraction is the ratio of?
answer: Area at vena contracta / area of orifice
card text: Cc = area of jet at vena contracta / area of orifice. Cv = actual/theoretical velocity. Cd = Cc × Cv.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Mechanical efficiency of an impulse turbine is?
answer: Power at shaft / power given to the wheel
card text: Mechanical efficiency = shaft power ÷ power delivered by water to the runner.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Cycle with one constant-pressure, one constant-volume and two isentropic processes?
card text: Diesel cycle: isentropic compression, constant-pressure heat addition, isentropic expansion, constant-volume heat rejection.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Heat needed to raise unit mass of gas by one degree at constant volume is?
card text: Specific heat at constant volume (Cv) = heat to raise 1 kg by 1 °C at constant volume. Cp > Cv.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: In an adiabatic process?
card text: Adiabatic: no heat transfer; temperature changes; change in internal energy equals work done.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Compression ratio of a petrol engine?
card text: Petrol (SI) engines: compression ratio about 6–10 (older textbooks say 5–8). Diesel: 15–22.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: In a boiler water-level gauge glass, the other end of the tube connects to?
card text: A water-level gauge glass connects at the bottom to the water space and at the top to the steam space.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Swept volume of all cylinders together is called?
card text: Engine capacity (cubic capacity) = swept volume of all cylinders together.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Ovality and taper are measured for?
card text: Cylinder bore ovality and taper are measured with a bore gauge to check wear.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: An antifreeze solution is used as?
card text: Antifreeze mixed with water is used as engine coolant.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Pump and injector combined in one unit — which system?
card text: In a unit injector system, the pump and injector are one unit at each cylinder.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Closing of a valve after TDC or BDC is called?
card text: Valve lag = valve closes after dead centre. Valve lead = opens before. Overlap = both valves open together.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Plastigauge is used to measure?
card text: Plastigauge (a soft plastic thread) measures crankshaft and connecting-rod bearing oil clearance.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: The main purpose of the harmonic balancer is to control?
card text: The harmonic balancer (vibration damper) on the crankshaft front end reduces torsional vibration.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Which is NOT a part of the crankshaft?
card text: Crankshaft parts: main journals, crankpins, webs, counterweights. 'Shank' belongs to the connecting rod.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Rapid movement of air from the cylinder edges to the centre at the end of compression is?
card text: Squish is the inward rush of mixture as the piston comes close to the head near TDC.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Which metal is NOT used in a catalytic converter?
card text: Catalytic converters use platinum, palladium and rhodium — not chromium.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: In a Hotchkiss drive, torque reaction is taken by?
card text: In a Hotchkiss drive, the leaf springs take driving thrust and torque reaction.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: The clutch release bearing is also called?
card text: The clutch release bearing is also called the throw-out bearing.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: System that holds a steady speed so the driver can take the foot off the accelerator?
card text: Cruise control keeps the vehicle at a set speed without the driver pressing the accelerator.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Paddle shift is used in which gearbox?
card text: Paddle shifters behind the steering wheel are used with sequential (and automated) gearboxes.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: 'Fading' is a complaint of?
card text: Brake fade is loss of braking power when brakes become very hot, e.g. on long downhill runs.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: A 'shackle' is part of the?
card text: The shackle is part of the leaf spring assembly; it lets the spring length change.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: An SI engine that keeps running for a while after the ignition is switched off is said to be?
card text: Dieseling (run-on): an SI engine keeps firing after switch-off, due to hot spots or carbon igniting the mixture.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: The ballast resistor in an ignition system helps?
card text: The ballast resistor is bypassed during cranking, giving full battery voltage to the coil for easier cold starting.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: The length of the threaded part of a spark plug is called?
card text: Spark plug 'reach' is the length of its threaded part.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Purpose of the overrunning clutch in a starter drive?
answer: Protect the motor from being over-speeded
card text: The overrunning (one-way) clutch lets the pinion freewheel once the engine starts, so the engine cannot spin the starter too fast.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Steering 'wander' means?
card text: Wander: the vehicle drifts to one side or the other and needs constant correction.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Angle between the wheel's vertical line and its tilt, seen from the front?
card text: Camber = tilt of the wheel from vertical, seen from the front.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: In an air brake system, the brake chamber is used to?
card text: The brake chamber turns air pressure into push on the slack adjuster, which rotates the S-cam and applies the brake.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Which part reduces body roll when turning?
card text: The stabiliser (anti-roll) bar links left and right suspension to reduce body roll on turns.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Angle between the vehicle's direction of motion and the tyre's centre plane?
card text: Slip angle = angle between the tyre's heading and its actual path.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: The plumb line method checks defects in?
card text: The plumb-line (diagonal) method checks chassis frame alignment after an accident.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Which is NOT a type of stub axle?
card text: Stub axle types: Elliot, Reversed Elliot, Lamoine, Reversed Lamoine. 'Elliptical' is not one.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Ply rating of a tyre indicates?
card text: Ply rating indicates the tyre's relative strength (load capacity), not the real number of plies.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: A motor vehicle built to carry more than 6 persons excluding the driver is?
card text: Omnibus (Section 2(29)): any motor vehicle built or adapted to carry more than 6 persons excluding the driver.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Inward cross slope of the road on a horizontal curve is called?
card text: Super elevation (banking) raises the outer edge of a road on a curve.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Validity of first registration of a private car in India?
card text: A non-transport vehicle's first registration is valid for 15 years; then renewed for 5 years at a time.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: The yaw rate sensor in Electronic Stability Control measures?
answer: How fast the car is actually turning
card text: The yaw rate sensor measures how fast the car is actually rotating (turning) about its vertical axis.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: White smoke from a diesel engine is mainly due to?
card text: White smoke from a diesel engine mostly comes from low temperature (cold engine) — fuel or water vapour does not burn fully.

exam: Motor Transport Sub Inspector (Trainee), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: 'CRDI' is related to?
card text: CRDI = Common Rail Direct Injection, a diesel fuel system with a high-pressure common rail and electronic injectors.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Validity of a driving licence for transport vehicles?
card text: A licence to drive a transport vehicle is valid for 5 years (Section 14). Hazardous-goods licence: 3 years.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: On fast highways, how far behind a broken-down heavy vehicle are warning triangles placed?
card text: Place reflective warning triangles about 50 metres behind a broken-down vehicle on a highway.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Maximum speed while towing another vehicle?
card text: A vehicle towing another vehicle must not go faster than 25 km/h.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Section 134 of the MV Act, 1988 deals with?
answer: Driver's duty when an accident injures a person
card text: Section 134: duty of the driver in case of an accident and injury to a person — get medical help and inform police.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Registration plate colour for battery-operated electric transport vehicles?
card text: Electric vehicles have green plates: transport EVs yellow letters on green; private EVs white letters on green.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Minimum tread depth (CMVR) for tyres of vehicles other than tractors, two- and three-wheelers?
card text: Minimum tread (non-skid) depth: 1.6 mm for cars and heavier vehicles; 0.8 mm for two- and three-wheelers.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Minimum age to get a driving licence for transport vehicles?
card text: Minimum age to drive a transport vehicle is 20 years (Section 4).

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Unpaid work done as punishment under the amended MV Act is called?
card text: The MV (Amendment) Act, 2019 added 'community service' — unpaid work for the public — as a punishment for some offences.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: A major part of the engine cooling system is?
card text: The radiator is the main part of the water cooling system; it passes engine heat to the air.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Heating hypo-eutectoid steel 50 °C above A3, holding, then cooling slowly in the furnace is?
card text: Full annealing: heat steel above the critical temperature, hold, then cool very slowly in the furnace. It makes steel soft.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Unit of dynamic viscosity?
card text: Dynamic viscosity units: N·s/m² = Pa·s (SI); poise (CGS). 1 Pa·s = 10 poise.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Differential manometer with mercury and oil (sp. gr. 0.68), mercury level difference 30 cm. Pressure head difference in metres of oil?
card text: Differential manometer: head difference = x (S_heavy/S_light − 1). Here 0.3 × (13.6/0.68 − 1) = 0.3 × 19 = 5.7 m of oil.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Which notch gives the most accurate discharge measurement?
card text: A triangular (V) notch measures discharge most accurately, especially for small flows.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: For incompressible 3-D flow, given u and v, how is the third velocity component found?
card text: Continuity for incompressible 3-D flow: ∂u/∂x + ∂v/∂y + ∂w/∂z = 0. So ∂w/∂z = −(∂u/∂x + ∂v/∂y).

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Two turbines have the same specific speed and head; speed ratio N1/N2 = 3. Power ratio P1/P2?
card text: Specific speed Ns = N√P / H^(5/4). Same Ns and H means N√P is constant, so P ∝ 1/N². Here P1/P2 = 1/9.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Which impeller blade shape gives a centrifugal pump the maximum efficiency?
card text: Backward-curved impeller blades give the highest efficiency in centrifugal pumps.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Which beam has a portion with constant bending moment?
card text: In four-point bending (two equal loads), the bending moment is constant between the two inner loads, and shear force there is zero.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Unwin's formula for rivet hole diameter d (plate thickness t, mm)?
card text: Unwin's formula: rivet diameter d = 6√t (d and t in mm).

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: In an M16 bolt, 16 stands for?
card text: In metric bolt M16, 16 is the nominal (major) diameter in mm.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Ultimate strength 400 MPa, working stress 100 MPa. Margin of safety?
card text: Factor of safety = ultimate stress / working stress = 4. Margin of safety = FOS − 1 = 3.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Which is correct about volumetric efficiency of an IC engine?
card text: Volumetric efficiency = actual air drawn in ÷ air that would fill the swept volume at atmospheric conditions. Usually 80–100%; turbocharging raises it.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Cycle: adiabatic compression, constant-volume heat addition, constant-pressure heat addition, adiabatic expansion, constant-volume heat rejection?
card text: Dual (mixed/limited-pressure) cycle adds heat partly at constant volume and partly at constant pressure.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: The difference between higher and lower calorific value of a fuel is due to?
card text: HCV − LCV = latent heat of the water vapour formed by burning hydrogen in the fuel.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: In which compression process is the work done on air maximum?
card text: Irreversible adiabatic compression needs the most work; isothermal needs the least.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Emissive power of a grey body compared with a black body at the same temperature?
card text: A grey body emits less than a black body at the same temperature (emissivity less than 1).

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Duration of one intake stroke of a four-stroke engine at 3000 rpm?
card text: At 3000 rpm one revolution takes 20 ms; one stroke is half a revolution = 10 ms.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: The piston forms which part of the combustion system?
card text: The piston is the moving boundary of the combustion chamber.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Crankshaft of a four-stroke engine turns at 3000 rpm. Camshaft speed?
card text: In a four-stroke engine the camshaft turns at half crankshaft speed: 3000 → 1500 rpm.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: At high altitude, carburettor fuel supply should be ___ to keep the same fuel-air ratio.
card text: At high altitude, air is thinner, so fuel supply must be reduced to keep the mixture correct.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Which factor does NOT significantly affect carburetion?
card text: Carburetion depends on engine speed, carburettor design and intake air temperature — not on the number of cylinders.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Objectives of a diesel injection nozzle: atomise, distribute evenly, avoid wall wetting, dribble. Which are correct?
card text: A good injector nozzle atomises fuel, spreads it evenly and avoids wetting the walls. It must NOT dribble.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: The S.U. carburettor is generally of which type?
card text: The S.U. carburettor is a side-draught, constant-vacuum (variable choke) carburettor.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Mechanic A: some rings control blow-by. Mechanic B: some rings control oil. Who is right?
card text: Compression rings stop blow-by of gas; oil control rings scrape extra oil off the cylinder wall.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: The most commonly used antifreeze is?
card text: Ethylene glycol is the most common antifreeze. It lowers the freezing point and raises the boiling point of coolant.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Which device stops coolant circulation to the radiator so the engine warms up fast?
card text: The thermostat stays closed when the engine is cold, so it warms up quickly.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: The cadmium test is done to find?
card text: The cadmium test checks the condition of each battery plate group (positive and negative) using a cadmium probe.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: During battery discharge, which are true: (i) both plates turn to PbSO4 (ii) specific gravity falls (iii) terminal voltage rises?
card text: When a lead-acid battery discharges, both plates become lead sulphate and electrolyte specific gravity falls. Voltage falls, not rises.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: The rate at which a battery gives current depends on?
answer: All four: current demand, electrolyte strength, temperature and plate area.
card text: Battery output depends on current demand, electrolyte strength, temperature and plate surface area.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: The cut-out relay in a vehicle is used to?
answer: Prevent battery discharge through the generator when the engine is off
card text: The cut-out relay disconnects the dynamo from the battery when the engine is slow or stopped, so the battery does not discharge through it.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: 'Lock torque' of a starter motor is?
answer: Torque when current is switched on and the armature starts from rest
card text: Lock torque is the torque a starter motor makes at the moment current is switched on and the armature is still at rest — its maximum torque.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Why are alternators preferred to DC generators?
answer: Better weight-to-power, low maintenance, high output at low speed
card text: Alternators are lighter for their power, need little maintenance (slip rings, no commutator) and give good output even at idle.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Spark plug tip temperature range that avoids both pre-ignition and fouling?
card text: A spark plug tip should stay between about 450 °C and 850 °C.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Which are true for a 'hot' spark plug?
answer: Longer heat path and longer insulator nose
card text: A hot plug has a long insulator nose and a long heat path, so it stays hot. Cold plugs have short noses.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Two-wheeler frame made of many short tubes welded together?
card text: A trellis frame is made of many short steel or aluminium tubes welded in a triangle pattern.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: With leaf, coil or rubber springs, bounce frequency ___ as sprung mass is ___.
card text: With ordinary springs, an empty (lighter) vehicle bounces at a higher frequency — the ride gets harsh when unloaded.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Steering ratio 15; wheels turn 30° each side from centre. Lock-to-lock turns of the steering wheel?
card text: Steering ratio = steering wheel angle / road wheel angle. 60° total wheel movement × 15 = 900° = 2.5 turns.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Brake system mainly used in heavy-duty vehicles?
card text: Heavy vehicles mainly use compressed air (air) brakes.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: For the same torque as a single-plate clutch, adding plates in a multi-plate clutch makes its diameter?
card text: More friction plates give more friction surfaces, so a multi-plate clutch can be smaller in diameter for the same torque.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Double declutching is done in which gearbox?
card text: As per this PSC key, double declutching is used in the constant-mesh gearbox to match gear speeds when changing gear.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: In a full-floating axle, the hubs on the axle casing are supported by?
card text: In a full-floating rear axle, each hub runs on two taper roller bearings on the axle casing; the half shaft carries only torque.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: The horseshoe-shaped inner part of a tyre made of textile cord plies is the?
card text: The carcass is the tyre's body of cord plies; it gives strength and holds the air pressure.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Anti-knock quality of petrol is measured as?
card text: Octane number measures petrol's resistance to knock. Cetane number measures diesel's ignition quality.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Correct order of combustion in an SI engine?
card text: SI engine combustion has three stages: ignition lag, flame propagation, after-burning.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: In a CI engine, as engine output increases, the delay period?
card text: In a CI engine, higher output (more fuel, hotter chamber) shortens the ignition delay period.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Which is NOT a limitation of supercharging?
card text: Higher intake air density is the aim (benefit) of supercharging. Its limits are more knock, thermal stress and heat loss.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Carnot engine takes heat at 327 °C and rejects at 27 °C. Efficiency?
card text: Carnot efficiency = 1 − T2/T1 (in kelvin) = 1 − 300/600 = 50%.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Which is NOT an air-standard cycle assumption?
card text: Air-standard assumptions: air is a perfect gas, mass is constant, processes are internally reversible, no heat loss.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Morse test finds approximate indicated power of a?
card text: Morse test works only on multi-cylinder engines; one cylinder is cut off at a time.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Which exhaust smoke colour shows worn piston rings or scored cylinder walls?
card text: Blue smoke = engine oil burning (worn rings, scored walls, worn valve guides). Black = rich mixture. White = water or cold engine.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Excessive wear at the centre of the tyre tread shows?
card text: Over-inflation wears the centre of the tread. Under-inflation wears both edges.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Rapid in-and-out wobble of the front wheels about the steering axis is called?
card text: Shimmy is a fast side-to-side wobble of the front wheels. Tramp is up-and-down hopping.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Which are duties of a conductor: not smoke, unduly delay journey, issue ticket, check concession documents, ring bell?
card text: A conductor must not smoke on duty, must issue tickets, check concession papers and ring the bell. Delaying the journey is not allowed.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Which are true of third-party insurance?
answer: Covers others' persons/property; cars renew annually
card text: Third-party insurance covers injury or damage to other people and their property, not your own vehicle. It is compulsory (Section 146).

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Causes of a spongy brake pedal?
answer: All: air in the system, shoes out of adjustment, faulty master cylinder, leaking lines, loss of fluid.
card text: A spongy brake pedal is mainly caused by air in the hydraulic system; also bad adjustment, faulty master cylinder, leaks and fluid loss.

exam: Motor Transport Inspector (Technical), Police Motor Transport Wing
question: Thrust bearing wear causes excessive crankshaft?
card text: A worn crankshaft thrust bearing allows too much crankshaft end play (front-to-back movement).

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Viscosity of liquids decreases when temperature rises. Why?
card text: In liquids, heat weakens the pull between molecules (cohesion), so the liquid flows more easily — viscosity goes down.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: In a Newtonian fluid, shear stress is ___.
answer: Directly proportional to rate of deformation
card text: Newton's law of viscosity: shear stress = viscosity × rate of shear strain (velocity gradient du/dy).

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Which is correct about fire point and flash point?
answer: Fire point is higher than flash point
card text: Fire point is always higher than flash point. Flash point: vapour flashes for a moment. Fire point: oil keeps burning.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Flow in which velocity at a given time does not change from point to point (with space) is called?
card text: Uniform flow: velocity is the same at every point (no change with space). Steady flow: velocity does not change with time.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Why is a venturimeter preferred to an orifice meter?
card text: A venturimeter loses much less energy (head) than an orifice meter, because its throat narrows and widens smoothly.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Hydraulic radius (hydraulic mean depth) equals?
card text: Hydraulic radius (hydraulic mean depth) m = flow area A / wetted perimeter P.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Unit of Chezy's constant C?
card text: Chezy's constant C has the unit m^½/s (square root of metre per second).

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Which causes the significant (major) head loss in pipe flow?
card text: Friction at the pipe wall is the major loss in pipe flow. Bends, enlargements and contractions are minor losses.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: 'Energy of an isolated system is always constant' is given by which law?
card text: First law of thermodynamics: energy is neither created nor destroyed. Energy of an isolated system stays constant.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: A series of operations in a fixed order that brings the system back to its initial state is called?
card text: A thermodynamic cycle is a series of processes that returns the working substance to its starting state.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: The most efficient way to compress air is?
card text: Isothermal compression (temperature kept constant) needs the least work, so it is the most efficient way to compress air.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: 1 °C equals?

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Which device works on the Clausius statement of the second law?
card text: Clausius statement: heat cannot flow from a cold body to a hot body without outside work. A refrigerator follows it.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: The Carnot cycle consists of?
card text: Carnot cycle = 2 isothermal + 2 isentropic (reversible adiabatic) processes.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Ratio of brake power to indicated power of an IC engine is?
card text: Mechanical efficiency = Brake power / Indicated power.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Morse test on a multi-cylinder engine is used to find?
card text: Morse test finds the indicated power (and friction power) of a multi-cylinder engine by cutting off one cylinder at a time.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Thermal conductivity of copper when temperature rises?
card text: For pure metals like copper, thermal conductivity decreases as temperature rises.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Heat loss from an insulated pipe to still surrounding air is mainly by?
card text: Heat from a hot surface to still air goes mainly by natural (free) convection.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: A sliding bearing that carries steady loads with no relative motion of journal and bearing is?
card text: A hydrostatic bearing gets its oil film from an outside pump, so it can carry load even when the shaft is not turning.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Piston pin bearings in heavy-duty diesel engines are?
card text: Needle roller bearings are used for piston pins in heavy diesel engines.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Spur gear with pitch circle diameter D and T teeth — module m is?
card text: Module m = pitch circle diameter D / number of teeth T (in mm).

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Bearing characteristic number (Z = viscosity, N = speed in rpm, p = bearing pressure) is?
card text: Bearing characteristic number = ZN/p (viscosity × speed / pressure).

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Difference between tooth space and tooth thickness, measured on the pitch circle, is called?
card text: Backlash = tooth space − tooth thickness, measured along the pitch circle.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Height of a Watt governor (N = speed in rpm)?
card text: Watt governor height h = 895/N² metres (N in rpm).

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Which device puts out the boiler furnace fire when water level falls to an unsafe level?
card text: A fusible plug melts when water level falls too low; steam and water rush in and put out the furnace fire.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Modulus of elasticity is the ratio of?
card text: Modulus of elasticity (Young's modulus) E = stress / strain, within the elastic limit.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Ratio of lateral strain to linear (longitudinal) strain is?
card text: Poisson's ratio = lateral strain / longitudinal strain. For steel it is about 0.3.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Centre of gravity of an equilateral triangle of side a lies at what distance from any side?
card text: In an equilateral triangle, the CG is one-third of the height from each side: (1/3)(a√3/2) = a/(2√3).

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Moment of inertia of a triangle (base b, height h) about its CG axis parallel to the base?
card text: Triangle: I about CG axis parallel to base = bh³/36. About the base itself = bh³/12.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Bending moment at the centre of a simply supported beam with UDL w per metre over span l?
card text: Simply supported beam with UDL w over span l: maximum bending moment at centre = wl²/8.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Shearing strength of one rivet (diameter d, permissible shear stress τ) in single shear?
card text: Shearing strength of one rivet in single shear Ps = (π/4)d² × τ.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Strength P of a fillet weld with weld area A and permissible stress σ?
card text: Strength of a weld P = throat area A × permissible stress.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Load needed to produce unit deflection in a spring is called?
card text: Spring stiffness (spring rate) k = load / deflection — the load for 1 unit of deflection.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Which is true of a two-stroke engine?
answer: Only ports covered and uncovered by the piston for charging and exhaust
card text: A simple two-stroke engine has no valves: the piston opens and closes ports for charging and exhaust.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: In an SI engine, what gives the required firing order?
card text: The distributor sends the high-voltage spark to each spark plug in the correct firing order.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: In a four-stroke engine, power is produced?
card text: A four-stroke engine gives one power stroke every two crankshaft revolutions (every alternate revolution).

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Cross-section of compression rings is usually?
card text: Compression rings usually have a rectangular cross-section.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: The distance between the centres of the front wheels is called?
card text: Track (tread) = distance between the centres of the left and right wheels on one axle. Wheel base = front axle to rear axle.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: The venturi in a carburettor causes?
card text: The venturi (narrow throat) speeds up the air, which lowers pressure and sucks fuel from the jet.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: A turbocharger uses ___ energy.
card text: A turbocharger uses the energy of exhaust gas to spin a turbine that drives the intake air compressor.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: The thermostat in the cooling system controls?
card text: The thermostat controls water flow to the radiator, and by that it controls engine water temperature.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Lubrication system where oil is kept in a separate tank and fed to the engine?
card text: Dry sump: oil is stored in a separate tank, not in the crankcase sump. Wet sump: oil sits in the sump under the crankcase.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Technology that changes the timing of intake/exhaust valves while the engine runs?
card text: VVT (Variable Valve Timing) changes when the valves open and close while the engine runs.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Members that join the longitudinal chassis members across are called?
card text: Cross members are the transverse pieces joining the two long side members of a ladder frame.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Vehicle weight produces which load in the frame side members?
card text: The weight of the vehicle and load bends the frame side members vertically (vertical bending).

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Suspension spring most commonly used in heavy vehicles?
card text: Heavy vehicles (buses, lorries) mostly use semi-elliptic leaf springs.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: In a recirculating-ball steering gear, the balls run between the ball nut and the?
card text: In recirculating-ball steering, steel balls roll between the worm shaft and the ball nut.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Tilting of the front wheels in or out from the vertical, seen from the front, is?
card text: Camber = inward or outward tilt of the wheel from vertical, seen from the front.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: During braking, the push rod directly operates the?
card text: In a tandem master cylinder, the brake pedal push rod pushes the primary piston directly; the secondary piston is moved by fluid pressure.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Tyre marking 175/65 R14 82 S — the aspect ratio is?
card text: In 175/65 R14 82 S: 175 = width (mm), 65 = aspect ratio (%), R = radial, 14 = rim size (inch), 82 = load index, S = speed rating.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: The main function of the master cylinder is?
answer: Convert pedal force into hydraulic pressure
card text: The master cylinder converts the driver's pedal force into hydraulic pressure in the brake fluid.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: The parking brake generally acts on?
card text: The parking (hand) brake usually acts on the rear wheels.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Which part allows a leaf spring to change length as it bends?
card text: The shackle lets the leaf spring's length change as it flexes.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Where is the clutch located?
card text: The clutch sits between the engine (flywheel) and the gearbox.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: A disadvantage of the cone clutch is?
answer: Hard to disengage if cone angle is less than 20°
card text: A cone clutch tends to bind (hard to disengage) when the cone angle is small, below about 20°.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Gearbox in which all gears are always in mesh?
card text: In a constant-mesh gearbox all gears are always in mesh; dog clutches lock the chosen gear to the shaft.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Joint used when two shafts are inclined to each other?
card text: A universal joint connects two shafts at an angle and passes rotation between them.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Angle between the steering axis and the vertical, seen in the plane of the wheel (from the side)?
card text: Castor = backward or forward tilt of the steering axis from vertical, seen from the side.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: A disadvantage of magneto ignition is?
card text: Magneto ignition gives a weak spark at low (starting) speed.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Ignition timing is affected by?
answer: All: chamber design, throttle opening and engine temperature.
card text: Ignition timing depends on combustion chamber design, throttle opening (load) and engine temperature, as well as speed.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: 'Ply rating' of a tyre refers to?
card text: Ply rating shows the tyre's strength (load capacity), not the actual number of plies.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Which wheel cannot be used with a tubeless tyre?
card text: Wire (spoke) wheels cannot normally take tubeless tyres.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Essential parts of a battery ignition system?
answer: All: battery, ignition switch, ballast resistor.
card text: Battery (coil) ignition parts: battery, ignition switch, ballast resistor, ignition coil, contact breaker, condenser, distributor, spark plugs.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: The licensing authority may refuse a conductor's licence if?
answer: All: no minimum education, medically unfit, or earlier licence revoked.
card text: A conductor's licence can be refused for lack of minimum education, medical unfitness, or an earlier revoked licence.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Purpose of rhodium in a catalytic converter?
card text: In a three-way catalytic converter, rhodium reduces NOx; platinum and palladium oxidise CO and HC.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Types of multi-point fuel injection?
card text: This PSC key lists both port injection and throttle body injection as types of (multi-point) petrol injection.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Electronic fuel injection (EFI) gives precise control of?
answer: All: quantity, rate in stages and pressure.
card text: EFI precisely controls fuel quantity, injection rate (in stages) and injection pressure.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: In which year was the first electric car invented?
card text: The first crude electric carriage was built around 1832 (Robert Anderson, Scotland), as per this PSC key.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Common rail injection pressures are of the order of ___ bar.
card text: As per this PSC key, common rail (CRDI) injection pressure is about 1500 bar (modern systems reach 2000 bar and more).

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: In MPFI, which sensor sends engine speed information?
card text: As per this PSC key, the ignition (crank/ignition pulse) sensor sends engine speed information to the MPFI ECU.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: What causes photochemical smog?
card text: Photochemical smog forms when NOx and hydrocarbons (HC) react in sunlight.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: On a highway, reflective warning triangles are placed behind a broken-down vehicle at?
card text: Driving Regulations: place the reflective warning triangle about 50 metres behind a broken-down vehicle on a highway.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Order of priority among emergency vehicles?
card text: Priority order among emergency vehicles: fire service first, then ambulance, then police.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Under the Driving Regulations, 'traffic' includes?
answer: All: vehicles, pedestrians and herded animals.
card text: 'Traffic' includes all vehicles, pedestrians and animals being herded on the road.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: A vehicle may be overtaken from the left when?
answer: All three: multi-lane road, vehicle turning right, or stationary vehicle — when safe.
card text: Left-side overtaking is allowed only on marked multi-lane roads, when the vehicle ahead is turning right, or when it is stopped — and only if safe.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Fog lights are used only when visibility is poor, together with?
card text: Fog lights are used with dipped headlamps, only when visibility is affected.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: To get a learner's licence for a transport vehicle, one must have held an LMV licence for at least?
card text: To get a learner's licence for a transport vehicle, you must have held a light motor vehicle licence for at least 1 year.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: A person gets an LMV (non-transport) licence at 18 years 1 month. Valid until?
card text: A non-transport licence issued before age 30 is valid until the holder turns 40 (Section 14).

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: A licence to drive a transport vehicle carrying hazardous goods is valid for?
card text: A licence for vehicles carrying dangerous or hazardous goods is valid for 3 years (Section 14).

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: If licence renewal is applied for more than ___ after expiry, a competence test is needed?
card text: If you apply for renewal more than 1 year after the licence expired, you must pass the driving competence test again (Section 15).

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Which is NOT a vehicle class in Section 10(2) of the MV Act, 1988?
card text: Section 10(2) DL classes: motor cycle without/with gear, LMV, transport vehicle, road roller, adapted vehicle, other notified classes. 'Medium goods vehicle' is not a class now.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Which of these is NOT a transport vehicle?
answer: None — all three are transport vehicles.
card text: Section 2(47): transport vehicle = public service vehicle, goods carriage, educational institution bus or private service vehicle.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: A vehicle for more than 6 but not more than 12 passengers (excluding driver) for hire or reward is?
card text: Maxi cab (Section 2(22)): more than 6 but not more than 12 passengers, excluding driver, for hire or reward.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: A juvenile rides a motorcycle with the guardian's knowledge. Result?
card text: Section 199A: for a juvenile's offence, the guardian/owner is guilty — up to 3 years imprisonment and Rs 25,000 fine; registration is cancelled for 12 months.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: A goods carriage with GVW 11,500 kg is categorised as?
card text: Goods vehicle categories: N1 up to 3.5 t, N2 3.5–12 t, N3 above 12 t. 11,500 kg is N2 (medium).

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Which is excluded from purchase value for lifetime tax of a motor car (KMVT)?
card text: Under KMVT, 'purchase value' for lifetime tax includes GST and duties, but TCS (tax collected at source) is excluded.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Who is exempt from wearing a helmet while riding a motorcycle?
card text: Section 129 exempts a Sikh wearing a turban. Here the option said 'Sikh persons (turban or not)', so PSC keyed 'None'.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Which officer can seize and detain a vehicle for unpaid tax and auction it (KMVT Act)?
card text: Under the KMVT Act, the taxation officer — e.g. the Joint RTO — can seize, detain and auction a vehicle for unpaid tax.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Which vehicles are liable to green tax at new registration in Kerala?
card text: As per this PSC key, green tax at new registration in Kerala applies to diesel motor cars.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Cancellation of registration does NOT apply when the vehicle is?
card text: Moving a vehicle to another state needs a new registration mark (Section 47), not cancellation. Cancellation is for destroyed vehicles or ones taken out of India.

exam: Motor Vehicle Inspector / Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector (Motor Vehicles Dept)
question: Who can apply for a transport vehicle driving licence?
card text: Transport vehicle licence: minimum age 20 and at least 1 year of driving a light motor vehicle (Sections 4 and 7).
